score_rationale.reproducibility: Six technical sections and a formula workbook preserve CFR-level workload and totals.

score_rationale.item13: Storage equals .0004 of recordkeeping labor cost; proxy coefficient has no accessible derivation.

item15.detail: Technical sections2–7, Reasons for Changes; workbook sheet3 rows54–56.

assumptions: New reactor application forecasts use pre-application engagement.
Storage-to-labor factor assumes stable pages and storage technology.
Maintenance record time reduced4315 to3000 hours using staff experience.

reconstruction_issues: Fee rate is not independently established as respondent occupational compensation.
Storage proxy has no pages, price per page or digital-system basis.
ACU proposed200 rather than3580 hours for financial qualifications and12000 rather than7000 for FSAR; NRC rejected both using broader experience, without publishing underlying observations.
methods_worth_testing: Preserve adverse stakeholder burden estimates and agency disposition.
